an_unmeasurable_journal_publishes_nothing_rather_than_zero","test_the_size_is_still_published_when_the_ceiling_is_unreadable","test_the_heartbeat_is_zero_when_the_daemon_predates_the_dropin","test_the_heartbeat_is_published_even_with_no_dropin_installed","test_the_heartbeat_survives_an_unmeasurable_journal"],"spans":[[1,24],[104,105],[119,120],[194,196],[207,213],[222,226],[233,235],[239,240],[248,249],[257,259],[271,276],[283,284],[291,292]]},"tests/scripts/test_observability_pct_of_cap_b380.py":{"docs":["module","_function_source","test_every_overrun_reports_its_own_magnitude","test_the_helper_carries_no_clamp"],"spans":[[1,32],[50,51],[57,63],[105,108],[126,128]]},"tests/scripts/test_observability_var_tmp.py":{"docs":["module","test_the_percent_is_measured_over_the_tree_the_budget_governs","test_a_budget_overrun_publishes_its_true_ratio","test_an_unmeasurable_var_tmp_publishes_nothing_rather_than_zero","test_the_size_is_still_published_when_the_budget_is_unreadable","test_the_cleanup_heartbeat_is_published_on_every_tick_including_its_zero_path","test_the_hard_quota_heartbeat_reports_the_regime_the_box_is_actually_in","test_the_heartbeats_survive_a_var_tmp_that_cannot_be_measured","test_the_var_tmp_walk_is_wall_clock_bounded"],"spans":[[1,25],[122,123],[145,146],[208,210],[221,224],[233,236],[243,245],[249,251],[259,260],[268,270],[276,277],[290,292],[303,304],[312,314],[318,321]]}}""")
PAT=re.compile(r"#\s*(?:noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b|pragma:\s*no cover\b|pyright:|mypy:|ruff:|pylint:|(?:fmt|isort):\s*(?:on|off|skip)\b|nosec\b|coding[:=]|[A-Za-z][\w-]*(?:-ok|-via):)",re.I)
OWNERS=(ast.Module,ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)
def norm(raw,path):
 tree=ast.parse(raw,filename=path,type_comments=True); seen=[]
 def walk(node,parent="module"):
  q=parent
  if isinstance(node,(ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)): q=node.name if parent=="module" else parent+"."+node.name
  if isinstance(node,OWNERS) and q in M[path]["docs"] and node.body and isinstance(node.body[0],ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.body[0].value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.body[0].value.value,str):
   node.body[0].value.value="__ALLOWLISTED_PROSE__"; seen.append(q)
  for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node): walk(child,q)
 walk(tree)
 assert sorted(seen)==sorted(M[path]["docs"]),(path,"owner mismatch",seen,M[path]["docs"])
 for node in ast.walk(tree):
  if isinstance(node,ast.TypeIgnore): node.lineno=0
 return ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False)
def protected(raw):
 lines=raw.splitlines()
 return [lines[t.start[0]-1] for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(raw).readline) if t.type==tokenize.COMMENT and (t.string.startswith("#!") or PAT.search(t.string))]
def hunks(path):
 diff=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--unified=0",B,"--",path],text=True)
 for line in diff.splitlines():
  if not line.startswith("@@"): continue
  m=re.match(r"@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+\d+(?:,\d+)? @@",line); assert m,(path,line)
  start=int(m.group(1)); count=1 if m.group(2) is None else int(m.group(2)); end=start+count-1
  assert count>0 and any(start>=a and end<=b for a,b in M[path]["spans"]),(path,"outside allowlist",line)
for path in M:
 before=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{B}:{path}"],text=True)
 final=Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 assert norm(before,path)==norm(final,path),(path,"AST/runtime drift")
 assert protected(before)==protected(final),(path,"directive/shebang drift")
